subject: general
question: What is the symbol of RBI?

options.text: Bengal tiger in front of a palm tree

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal tiger in front of a palm tree**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The symbol of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is a **Bengal tiger in front of a palm tree**.
 
• The RBI, established in 1935, is India's central banking institution, which controls the issuance and supply of the Indian rupee.
 
• The symbol reflects the authority and the economic strength of the RBI in managing the country's monetary policy and ensuring financial stability.
 
• The emblem signifies the bank's commitment to fostering economic growth while maintaining financial discipline.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** was nationalized in 1949, and it plays a crucial role in the development strategy of the government.
 
• The RBI's primary functions include **regulating the issue of banknotes, maintaining reserves to secure monetary stability, and operating the credit and currency system of the country**.
 
• The RBI also acts as the regulator of the financial system, ensuring the country's economic health and stability.
 
• The central bank's headquarters is located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The RBI is responsible for the formulation and implementation of monetary policy, regulation, and supervision of the financial sector, management of foreign exchange, and issuance of currency.
